title: Forget Attention: Importance-Aware Attention Is All You Need
abstract: arXiv:2606.02332v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Attention retrieves content precisely, but its scores depend only on query--key products, leaving order and recency to positional encodings. Conversely, state-space models (SSMs) such as Mamba-3 track order and recency through input-dependent state transitions that decay and rotate, yet compressing context into a fixed-size state hampers precise retrieval. Hybrids like Samba and Hymba exploit this complementarity only across layers or heads, so SSM transitions never shape attention scores directly. The closest prior work, the Forgetting Transformer (FoX), adds an input-dependent forget gate to the scores but reweights attention by recency alone. We propose SSM-Informed Softmax Attention (SISA), which builds Mamba-3-style state transitions, rotation included, directly into the scores alongside FoX's gate. translated_title: 忘掉注意力：重要性感知的注意力就是你所需要的一切
translated_abstract: 注意力机制能够精确地检索内容，但其得分仅依赖于查询-键乘积，将顺序和时近性信息交由位置编码处理。相反，以Mamba-3为代表的状态空间模型（SSM）通过随输入变化、具有衰减和旋转特性的状态转移来追踪顺序和时近性，但将上下文压缩至固定大小的状态会妨碍精确检索。像Samba和Hymba这样的混合模型仅在层或头之间利用这种互补性，因此SSM的状态转移从未直接影响注意力得分。最接近的先前工作——遗忘变换器（FoX）——在得分上加入了依赖输入的遗忘门，但仅按时近性对注意力重新加权。我们提出了SSM感知的Softmax注意力（SISA），它将Mamba-3风格的状态转移（包括旋转）连同FoX的门控直接构建到注意力得分中。每个logit都获得该SSM会赋予该词元对的权重：即旋转后的SSM投影之间经过衰减的匹配。这种旋转……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出SSM感知的Softmax注意力（SISA），将Mamba-3风格的带旋转状态转移直接融入注意力得分并结合遗忘门，使每个注意力logit获得SSM式的衰减匹配权重，从而在保持精确检索能力的同时融合顺序与时近性建模。
en_tdlr: Proposes SSM-Informed Softmax Attention (SISA), which directly embeds Mamba-3-style state transitions, including rotation, into attention scores alongside FoX's forget gate, so each logit receives the decayed, rotated-SSM matching weight, combining precise content retrieval with order and recency tracking.
